findings.source_quote: | καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, ἐκ τίνος ὄρους θέλῃ ἐνεχθῆναι λίθους καὶ ἐμβληθῆναι εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῶν. | καὶ ἐκ μὲν τῶν ὀρέων οὐκ ἐκέλευσεν ἐνεχθῆναι, | ἐκ δέ τινος πεδίου ἐγγὺς ὄντος ἐκέλευσεν ἐνεχθῆναι. |
findings.english_quote: The builders’ question and the nearby-field command in paragraph 6 are two bar-marked editorial supplements retained provisionally from the selected working Greek.
findings.issue: The note incompletely identifies the editorial supplements. The selected source also marks the intervening negative mountain-command clause as a supplement. There are three marked spans here, not merely the two named in the note. Omitting the middle span from the disclosure obscures the editorial status of “He did not order them brought from the mountains,” although the translation itself faithfully retains that clause.
findings.suggested_revision: Revise the note to identify all three bar-marked supplements: the builders’ question, the statement that he did not order stones brought from the mountains, and the nearby-field command. Retain the provisional status and the existing limits on witness verification. Proposed wording requires fresh review.

findings.source_quote: | καὶ ἐπηρώτησαν αὐτὸν οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, ἐκ τίνος ὄρους θέλῃ ἐνεχθῆναι λίθους καὶ ἐμβληθῆναι εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῶν. | καὶ ἐκ μὲν τῶν ὀρέων οὐκ ἐκέλευσεν ἐνεχθῆναι, | ἐκ δέ τινος πεδίου ἐγγὺς ὄντος ἐκέλευσεν ἐνεχθῆναι. |
findings.english_quote: The builders’ question and the nearby-field command in paragraph 6 are two bar-marked editorial supplements retained provisionally from the selected working Greek.
findings.issue: Independent comparison with the Greek shows that the note omits a third marked supplement: the negative statement about bringing stones from the mountains. The simplified text incorporates that statement into “instead of the mountains,” but the note does not disclose its editorial status. Its description of only two supplements is therefore incomplete.
findings.suggested_revision: Identify all three marked supplements, including the negative mountain-command clause represented by “instead of the mountains.” Preserve the distinction between retained editorial reconstruction and surviving manuscript wording, together with the existing evidence limitations. Proposed wording requires fresh review.

summary: Both editions cover the selected source’s clauses and preserve its narrative distinctions. The disclosed working selection “three times” is supported by the supplied bounded project report and should not be removed merely because other reported texts omit the count. Both editions require correction of paragraph 6’s supplement disclosure. This review evaluates the supplied Greek, English, and attributed reports; it does not authenticate manuscript images, certify unseen editions, or establish exhaustive collation.
